requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL evaluate interpreted string interpolations by executing embedded parser expressions in the current runtime environment and concatenating their string values into the literal result.

case.given: A Kon source string defines a visible variable named name
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates an interpreted string containing a Kon profile interpolation for that name
case.then: The result SHALL include the current value of name converted to text.

case.given: A Kon interpreted multiline string contains an embedded Kon expression
case.then: The embedded expression SHALL be evaluated in the current runtime and its result SHALL be inserted into the output string.

case.given: A Knl interpreted multiline string contains an embedded Knl expression using square-bracket interpolation syntax
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates parser output for that string
case.then: The embedded expression SHALL be evaluated with Knl parser semantics and inserted into the output string.

case.given: A raw single-line or raw multiline string contains escape-like or interpolation-like text
case.when: RuntimeInterpreter evaluates the raw string node
case.then: The runtime SHALL return the literal text without escape expansion and without expression evaluation.

requirement.statement: The RuntimeInterpreter SHALL preserve interpreted string escape semantics for delimiter characters, backslash, newline, tab, and carriage return.

case.given: An interpreted string source escapes double quote characters
case.then: The result SHALL contain literal double quote characters.

case.given: An interpreted string source escapes the backslash before profile-specific interpolation syntax
case.then: The result SHALL contain the interpolation marker text literally rather than evaluating it.

case.given: An interpreted string source contains newline, tab, or carriage-return escapes
case.then: The result SHALL contain the corresponding control characters.
